name: brikama_leads
description: Strains of a serovar that has no public genome, read out of the literature. Brikama is O:8,20 and shares its formula with Goldcoast (O:6,8); it has 0 RefSeq assemblies, 0 catalogue strains and 0 machine-readable accession+serovar rows, so the only route to a genome is the isolates recorded here.
license: gspec curation (reading published tables and text); the strains belong to their submitters
caveat: A serovar NAME can be a place name: 'Brikama' is also a town in The Gambia, so a text search returns 14 papers of which most are about a health centre, not the serovar. Only serovar-style mentions are kept here.

leads.what_it_shows: Submitted as S. Goldcoast; the authors' own in-silico call was 'S. Goldcoast or S. Brikama' for the same isolate, i.e. the identical tie, resolved phenotypically to Goldcoast.

The serotype column is headed 'Predicted serotype after confirmation by serum agglutination' and reads literally 'Goldcoast or Brikama' - a reference laboratory ran agglutination and still could not split the pair.
Same column, same value: agglutination-confirmed, still ambiguous.

leads.isolate: (5 isolates, ids not in the full text)
leads.what_it_shows: Brikama is 4.6 % (n = 5) of a Gambian NTS collection and is overrepresented in Cluster 6, so five Brikama isolates exist in a published collection.
